SABERS_BASE_SABER_LINE_PRESSURE.why: Marks the character as having the Sabers base ability so combat/ext/wenxue_sabers.py's after_hit hook knows to run the once-a-turn 'choose one' on a qualifying saber hit (gain Edge Momentum, by default, or Guard Pressure the target if the player toggled that preference). The reviewed_final override removes the narrow auto-generated modifier variant this replaces.

tianxia.talent.sabers.saber_scare.why: Marks the character as knowing Saber Scare so combat/ext/wenxue_sabers.py's after_hit hook can run its 'reduce a creature to 0 HP with a Sabers talent, or score a critical hit with a saber' trigger. Choosing WHICH hostile within 30 feet when several qualify uses nearest-then-lowest-id as a stand-in for the player's free choice.

foundation.FOUNDATION_03_EMPTY_BOWL_SOUL.why: Gain 1 Empty Bowl Mark (max 1, once a round) after Wen Xue's own Healing Hymn, Dawn Ward, Rhythmic Guard, Harmonizing Breath or Mercy of Morning resolves on an ally or herself -- combat/ext/wenxue_foundation.py's technique_used hook calls combat/pressure.py's generate() with the 'wenxue_empty_bowl_support' reason at that moment, standing in for the printed 'feeds, heals, stabilizes, protects, comforts, or answers real need' trigger, which is otherwise a GM narrative call. Not automated: a Mark from succeeding a hunger/deprivation/fear/scarcity resistance check or save (Resist the Shortcut), since Wen Xue has no such check on her sheet.

tianxia.talent.radiance.dawnmark_scriptu.why: Marks the character as knowing Dawnmark Scripture so combat/ext/radiance_dawnmark.py's attack_resolved and turn_start hooks know to extend her real Dawnmark's duration to until the end of her next turn and to flare it (deny Reactions) when a bearer's turn starts.
